message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crime(s). Facts: Chen used false representation as dealer of Oumei company to get money from victim for purchase of product, but never delivered. This is fraud via contract (sale). Should be classified as 合同诈骗 (contract fraud) rather than generic 诈骗. The victim paid 24160 yuan. Chen returned money and got victim's forgiveness. Still fraud occurred. So charge: 合同诈骗. Possibly also "诈骗" but rule says use 合同诈骗. No other crimes. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>. JSON format.
